item.title: Update CHANGELOG.md and bump version to v0.3.6
item.intent: CHANGELOG.md must document every change since v0.3.5 and VERSION must read 0.3.6 so operators can track what shipped.
item.description: v0.3.5 was the last tagged version. Since then ~20 items completed: FEAT-031 (auto --limit), FEAT-033 (live progress counter), FEAT-034 (end-of-session summary), BUG-093 through BUG-109 — including worktree archive fix, --no-merge repick, --ready filter, scope display, history limit, --priority filter, status titles, and checksums safety. CHANGELOG.md needs a v0.3.6 section and VERSION must be updated.
steps: Run backlog history --all to list completed items since v0.3.5
Add a v0.3.6 section to CHANGELOG.md covering all completed items
Run shellcheck and confirm zero new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: CHANGELOG.md contains a v0.3.6 section with entries for FEAT-031, FEAT-033, FEAT-034, BUG-093 through BUG-109
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
